name: SVC_CHATS
description: This table is used for storing Chat Objects. It is referenced by ChatMessages

columns.name: CHAT_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references HZ_PARTIES (PARTY_ID) which is the account associated with the CONTACT_PARTY_ID.

columns.name: CONTACT_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references HZ_PARTIES (PARTY_ID), the customer contact of this work request.

columns.name: ASSIGNEE_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references HZ_PARTIES (PARTY_ID), the agent (resource)

columns.name: QUEUE_ID
columns.description: The id of the queue that the work object has been assigned to

columns.name: FIRST_NAME
columns.description: As entered by the customer in the Request Chat form

columns.name: LAST_NAME
columns.description: As entered by the customer in the Request Chat form

columns.name: EMAIL
columns.description: As entered by the customer in the Request Chat form

columns.name: QUESTION
columns.description: As entered by the customer in the Request Chat form

columns.name: CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references SVC_SR_CATEGORIES (CATEGORY_ID).

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.description: The inventory item that the chat is related to.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.description: The organization of the inventory item that the chat is related to.

columns.name: PROD_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references QSC_PROD_GROUPS_B (PROD_GROUP_ID), the product group that the product belongs in.

columns.name: INCIDENT_TYPE
columns.description: The incident type (received in the request engagement message) associated to the chat.

columns.name: INCIDENT_NAME
columns.description: Number or name of the referenced Business Object for which the chat was created.

columns.name: STATUS_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the status code of the chat, such as NEW, ACCEPTED, CANCELED, COMPLETED, TRANSFERRED, SUBMITTED, REQUEUED.

columns.name: TIER_ONE_SESSION_ID
columns.description: Identifies the end user's session in application context

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the interaction is logically deleted (Y or N).

columns.name: OSVC_CHAT_ID
columns.description: OSvC (RightNow)  chat Id from the Right Now Server.

columns.name: MERCURY_CONVERSATION_ID
columns.description: References conversation_alternate_id in table SVC_MC_CONVERSATION.

columns.name: MERC_CONV_DONE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether Mercury Conversation is done, Y or N, or null if there is no conversation.

columns.name: END_USER_SESSION_ID
columns.description: This column stores the end user session ID in chat server.

columns.name: CHAT_SOURCE
columns.description: The chat source, like "WCFS", "RW UI", "Facebook".

columns.name: CHAT_DIRECTION_CD
columns.description: Indicates who initiated, "Inbound" for customer initiated, "Outbound" for agent initiated.

columns.name: SUBSTATUS_CD
columns.description: Provides extra information of the current chat status.
